questions.question: A teacher notices that a child always compares fractions by looking only at denominators. Which move is MOST diagnostic? / शिक्षक को denominator-based persistent misconception दिखती है; सबसे diagnostic कदम?
options: Contrasting examples देकर reasoning elicitation / Elicit reasoning with contrasting examples
Rule फिर से याद कराना / Re-teach the rule
उत्तर बताकर practice / Give answer and practice
questions.explanation: Diagnostic teaching begins by exposing the learner's underlying reasoning.

i18n.hi: निदानात्मक शिक्षण में पहले बच्चे की underlying reasoning सामने लाई जाती है।
i18n.en: Diagnostic teaching first exposes the learner's underlying reasoning.

questions.question: ZPD-based scaffolding में 'fading' का सबसे सटीक अर्थ क्या है? / What is fading?
options: हर task में समान सहायता / Same help every time
Competence बढ़ने पर support धीरे-धीरे हटाना / Gradually withdraw support
Difficulty अचानक बढ़ाना / Suddenly increase difficulty
questions.explanation: Fading transfers control from teacher/scaffold to learner.

i18n.hi: Fading में competence बढ़ने के साथ support हटाया जाता है।
i18n.en: Fading gradually transfers control to the learner.

questions.question: Learning outcome है: 'evidence के आधार पर claim justify करना'. कौन-सा assessment सबसे aligned है?
options: Two sources से claim justify करना / Justify a claim using two sources
questions.explanation: The assessment must sample the same cognitive performance as the outcome.

i18n.hi: Evidence-based justification को सीधे assess करने वाला task aligned है।
i18n.en: The task directly samples evidence-based justification.

questions.question: Revised Bloom में 'evaluate' और 'create' का सही distinction क्या है?
options: दोनों recall हैं / Both are recall
Evaluate = criteria से judgment; Create = नया coherent product generate करना
questions.explanation: Evaluate involves judgment by criteria; create involves generating/constructing something new.

i18n.hi: Evaluate में criteria-based judgment, create में नया product generation होता है।
i18n.en: Evaluate is criteria-based judgment; create is generation/construction.

questions.question: Class participation high है लेकिन transfer low. सबसे उपयुक्त response?
options: Varied contexts में application + explanation tasks
questions.explanation: Transfer improves through varied-context application and explanation.

i18n.hi: Transfer के लिए varied contexts में application जरूरी है।
i18n.en: Transfer is strengthened by varied-context application.

questions.question: Constructive alignment का core क्या है?
options: Outcomes, learning activities और assessment की coherence
questions.explanation: Constructive alignment makes outcomes, pedagogy and assessment mutually supportive.

i18n.hi: Outcomes, activities और assessment coherent होने चाहिए।
i18n.en: Outcomes, activities and assessment should reinforce one another.

questions.question: Student सही answer देता है लेकिन reason नहीं बता पाता. Best next assessment move?
options: 'Why does your answer follow?' reasoning prompt
questions.explanation: A reasoning prompt distinguishes conceptual understanding from guessing.

i18n.hi: Reasoning prompt conceptual understanding को probe करता है।
i18n.en: A reasoning prompt probes understanding beyond answer accuracy.

questions.question: Wait-time का strongest pedagogic effect?
questions.explanation: Adequate wait time supports deeper processing and broader participation.

i18n.hi: Wait-time processing और response quality बढ़ाता है।
i18n.en: Adequate wait time supports processing and thoughtful participation.

questions.question: Readiness बहुत अलग है लेकिन learning goal common है. Differentiation का defensible form?
options: Weak learners को permanent low goals
questions.explanation: Differentiation varies access or demonstration while preserving meaningful goals.

i18n.hi: Core goal रखते हुए process/support/product vary करना उचित है।
i18n.en: Vary access, support or product while preserving meaningful goals.

questions.question: Formative assessment का strongest use?
options: Evidence के आधार पर ongoing instruction adjust करना
questions.explanation: Formative assessment is assessment for learning and informs instructional adjustment.

i18n.hi: Formative assessment ongoing instruction को adjust करने के लिए है।
i18n.en: It informs adjustment during the learning process.

questions.question: Multiple valid solutions वाले task में best rubric?
questions.explanation: Rubrics should score quality dimensions without forcing one valid form.

i18n.hi: Rubric multiple valid solutions को common quality criteria से assess करे।
i18n.en: Use shared quality criteria while allowing valid variation.

questions.question: Inquiry teaching में teacher की सबसे उपयुक्त role?
options: Questions, evidence, resources और reflection structure करना
questions.explanation: The teacher structures inquiry without replacing learner reasoning.

i18n.hi: Teacher inquiry को structure करता है, conclusion impose नहीं करता।
i18n.en: The teacher structures inquiry without replacing learner reasoning.

questions.question: Negative reinforcement का सही अर्थ?
options: Aversive condition हटाकर behavior की संभावना बढ़ाना
questions.explanation: Negative reinforcement increases behavior by removing an aversive condition.

i18n.hi: Aversive condition हटने से desired behavior बढ़ता है।
i18n.en: It increases behavior by removing an aversive condition.

questions.question: Growth-oriented feedback में किस पर जोर होगा?
options: Strategy, evidence, revision और next step
questions.explanation: Process-linked feedback makes improvement actionable.

i18n.hi: Strategy और next step पर specific feedback growth-oriented है।
i18n.en: Strategy-linked feedback makes improvement actionable.

questions.question: Prompting और scaffolding का सही relation?
options: Prompt एक targeted cue हो सकता है; scaffolding broader temporary support है
questions.explanation: A prompt can be one scaffold; scaffolding is the broader support system.

i18n.hi: Prompt scaffolding का एक targeted form हो सकता है।
i18n.en: A prompt can be one scaffold within a broader scaffold.

questions.question: Objective में compare/justify/critique हैं लेकिन test mostly recall है. Main concern?
questions.explanation: Recall-heavy testing underrepresents the intended cognitive demand.

i18n.hi: Recall-heavy test intended higher-order demand को underrepresent करता है।
i18n.en: Recall-heavy testing underrepresents the intended cognitive demand.

questions.question: Hidden curriculum किसे कहते हैं?
options: Implicit norms/values learned through routines and structures
questions.explanation: Institutional routines teach norms beyond the formal curriculum.

i18n.hi: School routines/structures से implicit norms सीखना hidden curriculum है।
i18n.en: Implicit norms learned through school structures form the hidden curriculum.

questions.question: Cooperative learning में groups बना देना पर्याप्त क्यों नहीं?
options: Positive interdependence और individual accountability चाहिए
questions.explanation: Effective cooperation requires structured interdependence and accountability.

i18n.hi: सिर्फ grouping नहीं; interdependence और accountability भी चाहिए।
i18n.en: Effective cooperation requires structured interdependence and accountability.

questions.question: UDL का central principle?
options: Multiple means of engagement, representation, action/expression
questions.explanation: UDL anticipates learner variability through multiple pathways.

i18n.hi: UDL multiple engagement, representation और expression pathways देता है।
i18n.en: UDL anticipates learner variability through multiple pathways.

questions.question: Writing weak है, oral strong है. Fair assessment का principle?
options: यदि writing construct नहीं है तो alternative response mode; यदि goal है तो writing assess करें
questions.explanation: Fairness depends on whether the response mode is part of the construct.

i18n.hi: Response mode को construct के अनुसार चुनना चाहिए।
i18n.en: Choose response modes according to the construct being assessed.

questions.question: Criterion-referenced assessment में interpretation किससे होता है?
questions.explanation: Performance is interpreted against defined criteria rather than peers.

i18n.hi: Performance predefined standard के विरुद्ध interpret होता है।
i18n.en: Performance is interpreted against predefined standards.

questions.question: Reliability और validity में सही distinction?
options: Reliability = consistency; validity = evidence supporting intended interpretation/use
questions.explanation: Consistency and validity evidence answer different questions.

i18n.hi: Reliability consistency है; validity intended interpretation के evidence से जुड़ी है।
i18n.en: Reliability concerns consistency; validity concerns the intended interpretation/use.

questions.question: Almost everyone gets an item correct. Item-level discrimination concern क्या हो सकता है?
questions.explanation: Very easy items may provide little separation among examinees.

i18n.hi: बहुत आसान item candidates को distinguish कम कर सकता है।
i18n.en: Very easy items may provide limited discrimination.

questions.question: Metacognition का clearest classroom indicator?
options: Plan-monitor-evaluate strategy and change it when needed
questions.explanation: Metacognition includes planning, monitoring and evaluating cognition.

i18n.hi: Planning, monitoring और strategy change metacognition के संकेत हैं।
i18n.en: Planning, monitoring and evaluating strategy are metacognitive behaviors.

questions.question: Peer assessment को stronger बनाने के लिए?
questions.explanation: Shared criteria and examples improve judgment quality.

i18n.hi: Clear rubric और exemplars peer judgment को बेहतर बनाते हैं।
i18n.en: Shared criteria and exemplars improve peer judgments.

questions.question: Project-based learning में driving question का role?
options: Sustained inquiry को organize करने वाला authentic open-ended question
questions.explanation: A driving question sustains inquiry around a meaningful challenge.

i18n.hi: Driving question sustained inquiry को organize करता है।
i18n.en: A driving question sustains inquiry around a meaningful challenge.

questions.question: Remedial teaching का evidence-based starting point?
options: Diagnostic evidence से specific gap identify करना
questions.explanation: Remediation should target a diagnosed learning gap.

i18n.hi: Remedial teaching diagnosed gap पर आधारित होना चाहिए।
i18n.en: Remediation should target a diagnosed gap.

questions.question: Same conceptual error repeatedly appears. Best feedback?
options: Misconception identify + contrasting case + revise reasoning
questions.explanation: The learner needs help reconstructing the underlying concept.

i18n.hi: Misconception को identify करके contrasting case से reasoning revise करानी चाहिए।
i18n.en: Feedback should target the misconception and reconstruction of reasoning.

questions.question: Authentic assessment सबसे accurately क्या sample करता है?
questions.explanation: Authenticity concerns meaningful context and application.

i18n.hi: Authenticity meaningful context में application से जुड़ी है।
i18n.en: Authenticity concerns meaningful context and application.

questions.question: Leading questions until the expected answer is given: main inquiry threat?
questions.explanation: Leading questions can steer inquiry toward a predetermined conclusion.

i18n.hi: Leading questions predetermined conclusion की ओर steer कर सकती हैं।
i18n.en: Leading questions can create predetermined closure.

questions.question: Differentiation by product का example?
questions.explanation: Product differentiation changes the demonstration format while retaining the target.

i18n.hi: Same target को अलग valid formats में demonstrate करना product differentiation है।
i18n.en: It varies the demonstration format while retaining the target.

questions.question: Math test में unnecessary language complexity reasoning को distort करती है. Threat?
questions.explanation: Unintended language demands add variance unrelated to mathematical reasoning.

i18n.hi: अनावश्यक language demand construct-irrelevant variance जोड़ सकती है।
i18n.en: Unintended language demands can add construct-irrelevant variance.

questions.question: Best feedback principle?
questions.explanation: Actionable feedback points to what can be improved next.

i18n.hi: Feedback specific, actionable और next-step oriented होना चाहिए।
i18n.en: Useful feedback is specific, actionable and future-oriented.

questions.question: A teacher wants to distinguish 'knows a formula' from 'can select and use it in novel contexts'. Best assessment?
options: Novel contextual problem requiring choice and justification
questions.explanation: Transfer requires selection and application, not recall alone.

i18n.hi: Novel context में selection + justification transfer को assess करता है।
i18n.en: Novel contextual application tests transfer beyond recall.

questions.question: Piaget के formal operational thought का strongest indicator कौन-सा है?
options: Systematic hypothesis testing with propositional reasoning
questions.explanation: Formal operations include systematic hypothesis testing and abstract/propositional reasoning.

i18n.hi: Formal operations में systematic hypothesis testing और abstract reasoning शामिल हैं।
i18n.en: Formal operations include systematic hypothesis testing and abstract reasoning.

questions.question: Piagetian assimilation vs accommodation: child uses an old schema for a new case without changing it. This is?
questions.explanation: Assimilation fits new experience into an existing schema.

i18n.hi: नई experience को existing schema में fit करना assimilation है।
i18n.en: Assimilation fits new experience into an existing schema.

questions.question: Vygotsky के अनुसार private speech का developmental significance क्या है?
questions.explanation: Private speech supports self-guidance and can become inner speech.

i18n.hi: Private speech self-regulation और problem solving में सहायक है।
i18n.en: Private speech supports self-regulation and can be internalized as inner speech.

questions.question: Erikson के अनुसार school-age period का central psychosocial conflict?
questions.explanation: School-age development centers on competence through industry versus inferiority.

i18n.hi: School-age stage में industry vs inferiority central है।
i18n.en: School-age development centers on industry versus inferiority.

questions.question: Kohlberg के conventional morality में 'good boy/good girl' orientation primarily किस concern से जुड़ी है?
questions.explanation: Stage 3 emphasizes interpersonal approval and being seen as good.

i18n.hi: Stage 3 interpersonal approval और relationship expectations पर केंद्रित है।
i18n.en: Stage 3 emphasizes interpersonal approval and relationships.

questions.question: Bandura के observational learning में vicarious reinforcement का अर्थ?
options: Model के consequence देखकर behavior probability बदलना
questions.explanation: Observed consequences can alter the observer's likelihood of reproducing behavior.

i18n.hi: Model के consequences देखकर observer का behavior बदल सकता है।
i18n.en: Observed consequences can alter the observer's behavior likelihood.

questions.question: Self-efficacy और self-esteem में सही distinction?
options: Self-efficacy = belief in capability for a task; self-esteem = broader self-worth evaluation
questions.explanation: Self-efficacy is capability belief; self-esteem concerns overall self-evaluation.

i18n.hi: Self-efficacy task capability belief है; self-esteem broader self-worth evaluation है।
i18n.en: Self-efficacy is task-capability belief; self-esteem is broader self-worth.

questions.question: Attribution theory में student कहता है 'मैं fail हुआ क्योंकि strategy गलत थी'. यह relatively?
questions.explanation: Strategy is internal and generally controllable, so it can support adaptive change.

i18n.hi: Strategy internal और relatively controllable factor है।
i18n.en: Strategy is an internal and relatively controllable attribution.

questions.question: Growth mindset का strongest teacher behavior?
options: Normalize effort plus strategy revision and challenge
questions.explanation: Growth-oriented practice links improvement to strategies, effort and learning conditions.

i18n.hi: Growth mindset में strategy revision और productive challenge पर जोर है।
i18n.en: Growth-oriented teaching emphasizes strategy, effort and challenge.

questions.question: A child can solve a conservation task only with concrete objects, not verbally. Piagetian interpretation?
options: Concrete operational understanding may be emerging/context-dependent
questions.explanation: Performance may depend on representational demands and concrete support.

i18n.hi: Concrete support के साथ conservation performance concrete operational reasoning से consistent हो सकता है।
i18n.en: Concrete support can be consistent with concrete operational reasoning.

questions.question: Scaffolding की Vygotskian logic में assessment का useful form?
options: Dynamic assessment that examines learning with mediated assistance
questions.explanation: Dynamic assessment probes modifiability through guided assistance.

i18n.hi: Dynamic assessment guided assistance के साथ learning potential को probe करता है।
i18n.en: Dynamic assessment examines modifiability with assistance.

questions.question: ‘Egocentrism’ in Piaget does NOT simply mean selfishness; it primarily refers to difficulty in?
questions.explanation: Piagetian egocentrism concerns perspective-taking limitations.

i18n.hi: Piagetian egocentrism perspective-taking difficulty से संबंधित है।
i18n.en: Piagetian egocentrism concerns difficulty taking another perspective.

questions.question: A child obeys rules mainly to avoid punishment. Kohlberg level/stage?
questions.explanation: Punishment-obedience is the first preconventional orientation.

i18n.hi: Punishment-obedience preconventional morality का शुरुआती orientation है।
i18n.en: Punishment-obedience is preconventional morality.

questions.question: Executive function में inhibition का classroom example?
options: Suppressing an impulsive response to follow task rules
questions.explanation: Inhibitory control suppresses a prepotent response.

i18n.hi: Impulsive response को रोककर rule-follow करना inhibitory control है।
i18n.en: Inhibitory control suppresses a prepotent response.

questions.question: Working memory की classroom relevance सबसे directly किसमें दिखती है?
options: Holding and manipulating information while solving a multi-step task
questions.explanation: Working memory temporarily maintains and manipulates information.

i18n.hi: Multi-step problem में information hold/manipulate करना working memory demand है।
i18n.en: Working memory supports holding and manipulating information.

questions.question: Intrinsic motivation के सबसे compatible classroom design?
options: Meaningful choice, optimal challenge, competence feedback
questions.explanation: Autonomy, competence and meaningful engagement support intrinsic motivation.

i18n.hi: Meaningful choice और competence-supportive feedback intrinsic motivation को support करते हैं।
i18n.en: Meaningful choice and competence support intrinsic motivation.

questions.question: ‘Learned helplessness’ के risk pattern में repeated uncontrollable failure का likely effect?
options: Expectations of lack of control and reduced persistence
questions.explanation: Repeated uncontrollable outcomes can reduce perceived control and persistence.

i18n.hi: Uncontrollable failure perceived control और persistence घटा सकता है।
i18n.en: Repeated uncontrollable failure can reduce perceived control and persistence.

questions.question: Temperament और personality के संबंध में safest statement?
options: Temperament refers to early-emerging reactivity/self-regulation tendencies; personality is broader
questions.explanation: Temperament is a narrower early-emerging dispositional construct within broader personality development.

i18n.hi: Temperament early-emerging reactivity/self-regulation tendencies को दर्शाता है; personality broader है।
i18n.en: Temperament is a narrower early-emerging construct than personality.

questions.question: Attachment theory में secure base behavior का example?
options: Child explores, returns to caregiver for reassurance, then resumes exploration
questions.explanation: A secure attachment supports exploration while the caregiver serves as a reliable base.

i18n.hi: Secure attachment में caregiver reliable base की तरह काम करता है।
i18n.en: Secure attachment supports exploration with the caregiver as a reliable base.

questions.question: A teacher labels a child 'lazy' after repeated incomplete work. Why is this psychologically risky?
options: It can shift attention from modifiable causes/strategies to fixed identity
questions.explanation: Trait labels can obscure task, strategy, context and support variables.

i18n.hi: Fixed label modifiable strategy/context causes को छिपा सकता है।
i18n.en: Trait labels can obscure modifiable strategy and contextual causes.

questions.question: Developmental principle 'cephalocaudal' means development proceeds broadly?
questions.explanation: Cephalocaudal describes a head-to-lower-body developmental direction.

i18n.hi: Cephalocaudal दिशा head से lower body की ओर है।
i18n.en: Cephalocaudal means development proceeds broadly from head downward.

questions.question: 'Proximodistal' development refers broadly to movement?
questions.explanation: Proximodistal describes development from the body's center outward.

i18n.hi: Proximodistal development center/core से extremities की ओर है।
i18n.en: Proximodistal development proceeds from the center outward.

questions.question: A child knows a rule but violates it when peers watch. Which distinction is most relevant?
options: Knowledge and self-regulation are not identical
questions.explanation: Knowing a rule does not guarantee inhibitory control, monitoring or social regulation.

i18n.hi: Rule knowledge और self-regulation अलग constructs हैं।
i18n.en: Rule knowledge does not guarantee self-regulation.

questions.question: Executive function is best understood as?
options: A set of control processes including inhibition, working memory and cognitive flexibility
questions.explanation: Executive function is a family of interrelated control processes.

i18n.hi: Executive function multiple control processes का समूह है।
i18n.en: Executive function is a set of interrelated control processes.

questions.question: Cognitive flexibility is most directly shown when a child?
options: Switches strategy/rule when task demands change
questions.explanation: Flexibility involves shifting perspectives, rules or strategies when needed.

i18n.hi: Task demand बदलने पर strategy बदलना cognitive flexibility है।
i18n.en: Cognitive flexibility involves shifting strategies or rules.

questions.question: A student says 'I am bad at maths' after one failure. A growth-oriented attributional reframe is?
options: You are not a maths person
That strategy did not work yet; let's identify what to change
questions.explanation: The reframe moves from fixed identity to modifiable strategy.

i18n.hi: Reframe identity से हटकर modifiable strategy पर focus करता है।
i18n.en: The reframe shifts from fixed identity to a modifiable strategy.

questions.question: Which memory process most directly converts attended information into a durable long-term trace?
questions.explanation: Encoding is the process by which information is transformed for storage.

i18n.hi: Encoding information को memory storage के लिए transform करता है।
i18n.en: Encoding transforms information for storage.

questions.question: Retrieval practice improves learning primarily because it?
options: Strengthens access pathways by actively recalling information
questions.explanation: Active retrieval strengthens later access more effectively than passive rereading alone.

i18n.hi: Active recall later retrieval को मजबूत करता है।
i18n.en: Active recall strengthens later access.

questions.question: A teacher uses spaced review rather than one long cram session. The main learning principle?
questions.explanation: Spacing distributes practice across time and generally improves retention.

i18n.hi: Spacing practice को समय में distribute करके retention improve करता है।
i18n.en: Spacing distributes practice over time and supports retention.

questions.question: Interleaving differs from blocked practice because interleaving?
options: Mixes related problem types/skills rather than practicing one type in a block
questions.explanation: Interleaving requires learners to discriminate among strategies while switching problem types.

i18n.hi: Interleaving different problem types mix करता है, जिससे strategy discrimination बढ़ती है।
i18n.en: Interleaving mixes problem types and strengthens strategy discrimination.

questions.question: A child can explain a concept to a peer but not reproduce the teacher's exact wording. This most directly suggests?
options: Conceptual understanding can exist without rote verbal reproduction
questions.explanation: Conceptual knowledge need not depend on reproducing exact wording.

i18n.hi: Conceptual understanding verbatim wording पर निर्भर नहीं होती।
i18n.en: Conceptual understanding does not require verbatim reproduction.

questions.question: ‘Scaffolding’ should ideally be removed when?
questions.explanation: Support should fade as learner control and competence increase.

i18n.hi: Independent performance संभव होने पर scaffold हटना चाहिए।
i18n.en: Support should fade as independent performance develops.

questions.question: A child attributes success to luck and failure to fixed ability. Which intervention best increases adaptive agency?
options: Highlight controllable strategies, preparation and feedback
questions.explanation: Controllable attributions make improvement pathways visible.

i18n.hi: Controllable strategies और preparation agency बढ़ाते हैं।
i18n.en: Controllable strategy-based attributions support agency.

questions.question: WHO-style life skills framework में 'decision making' का core क्या है?
options: Selecting among alternatives after considering consequences and information
questions.explanation: Decision making involves informed choice among alternatives with consequences considered.

i18n.hi: Decision making में alternatives, information और consequences consider होते हैं।
i18n.en: Decision making involves informed choice among alternatives and consequences.

questions.question: Problem-solving और decision-making में best distinction?
options: Problem-solving addresses a gap/problem; decision-making selects among alternatives
questions.explanation: Problem solving targets resolution; decision making selects a course of action.

i18n.hi: Problem-solving problem resolve करता है; decision-making alternatives में choice करता है।
i18n.en: Problem solving addresses a problem; decision making selects an action.

questions.question: Assertive communication सबसे accurately क्या है?
options: Clear, respectful expression of needs/rights while respecting others
questions.explanation: Assertiveness balances self-expression with respect for others.

i18n.hi: Assertive communication clear और respectful self-expression है।
i18n.en: Assertiveness expresses needs clearly while respecting others.

questions.question: A student refuses a risky peer invitation by saying, 'No, I don't want to do that; let's leave.' This is primarily?
questions.explanation: The response is clear, direct and respectful without attacking the peer.

i18n.hi: यह clear, direct और respectful refusal है।
i18n.en: It is a clear, direct and respectful refusal.

questions.question: Empathy differs from sympathy because empathy primarily involves?
options: Understanding/experiencing another's perspective without necessarily sharing the same judgment
questions.explanation: Empathy seeks perspective and emotional understanding rather than pity alone.

i18n.hi: Empathy दूसरे के perspective और feelings को समझने पर केंद्रित है।
i18n.en: Empathy focuses on understanding another's perspective and feelings.

questions.question: Active listening का strongest indicator?
options: Preparing your reply while they speak
questions.explanation: Active listening uses attention, paraphrase and clarification to verify meaning.

i18n.hi: Paraphrase और clarification understanding verify करते हैं।
i18n.en: Paraphrasing and clarification verify understanding.

questions.question: Conflict में 'I-message' का purpose क्या है?
options: Behavior और अपनी feeling/need को non-accusatory तरीके से express करना
questions.explanation: I-messages reduce blame by describing one's experience and need.

i18n.hi: I-message blame घटाकर अपनी feeling/need को express करता है।
i18n.en: I-messages reduce blame and express one's experience/need.

questions.question: Stress और distress में best distinction?
options: Stress is a response to demands; distress refers to stress experienced as harmful/overwhelming
questions.explanation: Stress can be adaptive; distress denotes excessive or harmful stress experience.

i18n.hi: Stress adaptive हो सकता है; distress harmful/overwhelming experience को दर्शाता है।
i18n.en: Stress can be adaptive; distress is excessive or harmful stress.

questions.question: Problem-focused coping is most suitable when?
options: A controllable aspect of the stressor can be changed
questions.explanation: Problem-focused coping targets changeable aspects of the stressor.

i18n.hi: Controllable aspects होने पर problem-focused coping उपयोगी है।
i18n.en: Problem-focused coping targets controllable aspects of a stressor.

questions.question: Emotion-focused coping is particularly useful when?
options: The situation cannot be immediately changed and emotional regulation is needed
A decision has already been made
questions.explanation: When the stressor cannot be quickly changed, regulating emotional response can be adaptive.

i18n.hi: Unchangeable situation में emotional regulation उपयोगी हो सकती है।
i18n.en: When a stressor cannot be changed immediately, emotional regulation can help.

questions.question: SMART goal में 'M' का अर्थ?
questions.explanation: SMART commonly uses Measurable for M.

i18n.hi: SMART में M = Measurable.
i18n.en: M stands for Measurable.

questions.question: A goal 'I will improve maths' is weakest because it lacks primarily?
questions.explanation: The statement is broad and lacks observable success criteria.

i18n.hi: Goal broad है और measurable indicator नहीं देता।
i18n.en: It lacks specific and measurable success criteria.

questions.question: Time management में Eisenhower-style urgent/important matrix का key idea?
options: Prioritize by urgency and importance rather than treating them as identical
questions.explanation: The matrix separates urgency from importance for prioritization.

i18n.hi: Urgency और importance को अलग करके priority तय की जाती है।
i18n.en: It separates urgency from importance to prioritize tasks.

questions.question: Digital literacy में phishing पहचानने का strongest clue?
options: Unexpected request for credentials/payment plus suspicious sender/link
questions.explanation: Credential/payment requests and suspicious links are common phishing indicators.

i18n.hi: Unexpected credential/payment request और suspicious link red flags हैं।
i18n.en: Unexpected credential/payment requests and suspicious links are common phishing indicators.

questions.question: Two-factor authentication improves account security primarily by?
options: Adding a second independent verification factor
questions.explanation: A second factor adds another layer beyond password knowledge.

i18n.hi: Second factor password के अलावा अतिरिक्त verification layer देता है।
i18n.en: A second factor adds an additional verification layer.

questions.question: Media literacy में 'source triangulation' का अर्थ?
options: Checking a claim against multiple credible and independent sources
questions.explanation: Triangulation compares evidence across credible sources.

i18n.hi: Multiple credible independent sources से claim verify करना triangulation है।
i18n.en: Triangulation checks claims across multiple credible sources.

questions.question: Confirmation bias का example?
options: Only seeking information that supports an existing belief
questions.explanation: Confirmation bias favors information consistent with existing beliefs.

i18n.hi: Existing belief को support करने वाली information चुनना confirmation bias है।
i18n.en: Confirmation bias favors information consistent with prior beliefs.

questions.question: Financial literacy में 'needs vs wants' distinction का practical use?
options: It helps prioritize essential spending before discretionary spending
questions.explanation: The distinction supports budgeting and prioritization.

i18n.hi: Needs-vs-wants budgeting में essential spending को prioritize करने में मदद करता है।
i18n.en: It helps prioritize essential over discretionary spending.

questions.question: Compound interest का key feature?
options: Interest can earn further interest as it accumulates
questions.explanation: Compounding means accumulated interest can itself become part of the earning base.

i18n.hi: Accumulated interest आगे interest earn कर सकता है।
i18n.en: Accumulated interest can itself earn further interest.

questions.question: Emergency fund का primary purpose?
options: Provide liquidity for unexpected essential expenses
questions.explanation: An emergency fund is a liquidity buffer for unforeseen essential costs.

i18n.hi: Emergency fund unexpected essential expenses के लिए liquidity buffer है।
i18n.en: It provides liquidity for unexpected essential expenses.

questions.question: A learner sees a viral financial claim and forwards it without checking. Best life-skill response?
options: Pause, verify source/evidence and check context
questions.explanation: Digital decision-making requires verification before amplification.

i18n.hi: Forward करने से पहले source/evidence/context verify करना चाहिए।
i18n.en: Verify source, evidence and context before amplifying a claim.

questions.question: Negotiation में BATNA का practical meaning?
options: Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement
questions.explanation: BATNA is the best alternative available if no agreement is reached.

i18n.hi: BATNA = agreement न होने पर available best alternative.
i18n.en: BATNA is the best alternative if no agreement is reached.

questions.question: A conflict escalates because both sides repeat positions. Which move best shifts toward interest-based negotiation?
questions.explanation: Interest-based negotiation explores why each side wants its stated position.

i18n.hi: Underlying interests पूछना positions से needs की ओर shift करता है।
i18n.en: Exploring underlying interests moves negotiation beyond fixed positions.

questions.question: Resilience is best understood as?
options: Capacity to adapt/recover while using support and learning from adversity
questions.explanation: Resilience includes adaptation and recovery, not absence of difficulty.

i18n.hi: Resilience difficulty की absence नहीं, adaptation/recovery की capacity है।
i18n.en: Resilience is adaptation and recovery, not absence of difficulty.

questions.question: Self-awareness in life skills most directly involves?
options: Recognizing one's emotions, strengths, limits, values and patterns
questions.explanation: Self-awareness includes internal states, strengths, limitations and patterns.

i18n.hi: Self-awareness emotions, strengths, limits और patterns को पहचानना है।
i18n.en: Self-awareness includes emotions, strengths, limits and patterns.

questions.question: Critical thinking differs from mere skepticism because critical thinking?
options: Uses evidence, reasoning and alternative explanations before judgment
questions.explanation: Critical thinking evaluates claims using evidence and reasoning rather than rejecting by default.

i18n.hi: Critical thinking evidence और reasoning से claims evaluate करता है।
i18n.en: Critical thinking evaluates claims using evidence and reasoning.

questions.question: A student receives conflicting instructions from two people. Best first life-skill move?
options: Clarify the goal, constraints and authority/source before acting
questions.explanation: Clarification reduces ambiguity before commitment.

i18n.hi: Goal, constraints और source clarify करना पहला उचित कदम है।
i18n.en: Clarify goals, constraints and authority before acting.

questions.question: Goal-setting and implementation intention differ because an implementation intention specifies?
options: A cue and planned response: 'If X happens, I will do Y'
questions.explanation: Implementation intentions link a situational cue to a planned action.

i18n.hi: Implementation intention cue और planned response को जोड़ता है।
i18n.en: An implementation intention links a cue to a planned response.

questions.question: Healthy digital boundaries most directly include?
options: Managing notifications, privacy settings and screen routines intentionally
questions.explanation: Digital boundaries involve deliberate control over access, attention and privacy.

i18n.hi: Notifications, privacy और screen routines को intentionally manage करना digital boundaries है।
i18n.en: Digital boundaries involve intentional control of privacy and attention.

questions.question: A person becomes angry during disagreement and immediately posts publicly. Best self-regulation sequence?
options: Pause, regulate arousal, clarify intent, then communicate
questions.explanation: A pause reduces impulsive action and allows deliberate communication.

i18n.hi: Pause और regulation के बाद intent clarify करके communicate करना बेहतर है।
i18n.en: Pausing and regulating arousal enables deliberate communication.

questions.question: 'Perspective taking' in conflict resolution helps because it?
options: Makes another person's constraints/needs cognitively visible
questions.explanation: Perspective taking broadens the representation of the problem and possible solutions.

i18n.hi: दूसरे की needs/constraints समझने से problem representation broaden होती है।
i18n.en: Perspective taking makes others' needs and constraints visible.

questions.question: Which is the strongest sign of responsible decision-making under uncertainty?
options: Identify options, risks, evidence gaps and choose/review accordingly
questions.explanation: Responsible decisions acknowledge uncertainty and include monitoring/review.

i18n.hi: Uncertainty, risks और evidence gaps पहचानकर decision/review करना responsible है।
i18n.en: Responsible decisions acknowledge uncertainty and include review.

questions.question: A student keeps a weekly reflection: 'What worked? What failed? What will I change next week?' This is primarily?
questions.explanation: Reflection links monitoring to strategy adjustment.

i18n.hi: यह monitoring और strategy adjustment वाली self-regulation है।
i18n.en: It links monitoring with strategy adjustment.
